title: CDS Compound Identity Card
description: Static chemical identity for one unique compound. Keyed by global comp_num_id. Contains all known names, structural identifiers (SMILES, InChI), and molecular formula. Sample/purity information lives in the per-DOI CCS INDIV card.

comp_num_id.description: Global compound registry ID. Required format: GLOBcomp_<positive integer>.

identity.description: Primary structural identifiers — the canonical key for this compound

SMILES.description: Canonical SMILES derived from InChI via RDKit. Null for ~61 compounds missing InChI. Primary structural search key.

InChI.description: IUPAC Standard InChI (sStandardInChI) — full canonical structure string. Null for ~6 compounds.

inchi_key.description: [audited] Present in 100.0% of cards. Example: AAAQKTZKLRYKHR-UHFFFAOYSA-N

names.description: All known names for this compound, collected and deduplicated across all papers in the database. Includes common names, trade names, IUPAC names.

primary_name.description: Most frequently used common name across all papers (chosen as the canonical display name)

all_names.description: All unique sCommonName values observed for this compound across the entire database, sorted by frequency (most common first). Median 2, max 29.

field_universe_audit.source: full scan of every card in the database (audit_card_fields.py)
